source_title: 93 Greenberg Traurig Attorneys Included on 2026 New York Metro Super Lawyers Lists
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ninety-three attorneys from global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP are included on the 2026 New York Metro Super Lawyers lists, with 59 named to the "Super Lawyers" list and 34 named to the "Rising Stars" list. In addition, Vice Chairman Robert J. Ivanhoe is recognized in the Super Lawyers Top 100 list.
The selection process is multiphased and includes independent research, peer nominations, and evaluations that identify a high degree of peer recognition and professional achievement, according to the Super Lawyers website .

About Greenberg Traurig: Greenberg Traurig, LLP has approximately 3,200 lawyers across 51 locations in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, and Asia. The firm's broad geographic and practice range enables the delivery of innovative and strategic legal services across borders and industries. Recognized as a 2025 BTI "Best of the Best Recommended Law Firm" by general counsel for trust and relationship management, Greenberg Traurig is consistently ranked among the top firms on the Am Law Global 100, NLJ 500, and Law360 400. Greenberg Traurig is also known for its philanthropic giving, culture, innovation, and pro bono work. Web: www.gtlaw.com .
